neighbours.label: forms of the verb 'rise' (risen, rising, rose, rise)
fire: Prices have risen sharply since the start of the year.
He had risen from humble origins to lead the company.
The water kept rising until it reached the second floor.
Both nations rose quickly to challenge the old empire.
Over the decade the cost of housing has risen by half.
Smoke was rising from the chimney of the old farmhouse.
Sales are expected to rise again after the holidays.
She rose to become the first woman on the court.
quiet: Prices have climbed sharply since the start of the year.
He had come from humble origins to lead the company.
The water kept spreading until it reached the second floor.
Both nations grew quickly to challenge the old empire.
Over the decade the cost of housing has grown by half.
Smoke was drifting from the chimney of the old farmhouse.
Sales are expected to improve again after the holidays.
She went on to become the first woman on the court.
